digest.component_or_area: Live Jira DC integration tests / bridge reconciler output parsing
propositions: The canonical sync route suppresses OK: summary output by design (gated at __main__.py:437), but test helpers asserted on OK: lines that the route never emits.
Commit c87afedba8 re-pointed DC harness cells at sync route, exposing stale assertions that expected output from a legacy route incompatible with the new canonical route.

BRIDGE_STATE: converged alone is insufficient evidence of zero writes because __main__.py classifies mutation-applying passes as CONVERGED; idempotence tests require both RECON differ totals (total=0) and absence of RECON batch_outcome lines to confirm nothing was written.

Test helpers must be rewritten to assert on stderr signals (BRIDGE_STATE, RECON differ totals, batch_outcome count) that the sync route actually emits, rather than stdout OK: summary that it deliberately suppresses.
